title: Consultant Management System
description: During my 2024 internship at AllPhi Westerlo, I collaborated with my fellow intern Govart to develop the Consultant Management System (CMS). The CMS is designed to serve as a single platform where HR can access all consultant data and update it across other platforms such as Salesforce, SD Worx, and others.

pageDetails.title: Home page
pageDetails.description: The home page shows relevant consultant information, to get an overview of AllPhi in general.

pageDetails.title: Consultant overview page
pageDetails.description: Shows all info about all consultants. Filters and search bar enables HR to find specific consultants with ease.

pageDetails.title: Consultant detail page
pageDetails.description: The details page for a specific consultant. Information about the consultant itself, their experiences and the current project.

pageDetails.title: Dashboard page
pageDetails.description: This page shows details about the work & projects of consultants. HR can filter on office, Gent, Brussels & Westerlo.

techStackDetails.title: Blazor
techStackDetails.description: Using Blazor, I created the front-end of CMS. I used best practices, created as much reusable components as made sense, and used tools like Polly to make it as reliable as possible.

techStackDetails.title: ASP.NET Core
techStackDetails.description: The API that provides the data for the application is build using ASP.NET Core. I used tools like MediatR, xUnit, Serilog and Seq to create and test a REST API. The backend is designed using the vertical slice pattern.

conclusion: I learned a lot about Blazor and ASP.NET Core, and how to create a reliable and scalable application. I also learned how to use tools like Polly to make the application more reliable. This internship gave me hands-on experience with working Agile in a team, how to build an application as a full-stack developer, and how real world enterprise apps work and are constructed.
